desc: Write the complete program: IO, precomputation (`inv`, exact `mult[a][c]`), numpy DP over `t` with closes-before-adds, row-window/offset bookkeeping, answer extraction and single-line output.
Validate model/GF against samples by exact combinatorics (N=4 full expansion; N=6 tree-count 810 and total 13000 at x=1).

Validate the program logic by full hand-simulation for N=4 (`12 9 3 0`), plus N=2 special case (`1`); index/offset, `delta`, row-clipping-as-pruning, `c+1>h` cut, close-before-add ordering and "no close at t=N" all verified.

Verify safety invariants: unique source per destination key, exact (non-reduced) multiplier with overflow bound ((2^a−1)2^c·(P−1) ≤ 2^29·10^9 < 2^63), shape bound lc+w+deg ≤ plens[t+1], inverses exist since P > N.
Estimate N=30 cost: ~2.2e5 numpy slice-adds and ~1e8 element ops with row/column trimming, ≈2–3 s and ≈55 MB — within budget; no further optimization needed.
